title: Conference Design for Consensus under KL Acceptance
abstract: arXiv:2610.33555v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study consensus formation and information acquisition in conferences where DeGroot-type opinion updating is constrained by an acceptance rule based on Kullback-Leibler divergence. Players choose private information experiments before deliberation, and these choices determine both their posterior distributions and acceptance tolerances. We establish sufficient conditions for global consensus under specified conference structures, including repeated bilateral conferences organized by a fully receptive mediator. Under full reimbursement of the mediator's conference costs, the information-acquisition game has a weighted potential and admits a pure-strategy Nash equilibrium. We develop a numerical procedure using verified payoff bounds over the continuous posterior domain to certify approximate equilibria and assess partial reimbursement policies that preserve a given equilibrium profile. translated_title: 基于KL接受准则的共识会议设计
translated_abstract: 我们研究会议中的共识形成与信息获取问题，其中DeGroot型观点更新受到基于Kullback-Leibler散度的接受规则约束。参与者在商议之前选择私人信息实验，这些选择同时决定了他们的后验分布和接受容忍度。我们在特定会议结构下建立了达成全局共识的充分条件，其中包括由完全接纳型的中介者组织的重复双边会议。当中介者的会议成本获得全额报销时，信息获取博弈具有加权势函数结构，并存在纯策略纳什均衡。我们开发了一种数值程序，利用连续后验域上经过验证的收益界来认证近似均衡，并评估能够保持给定均衡策略组合的部分报销政策。二值状态、三个参与者的例子说明了这些结果。
tldr: 本文研究了由KL散度接受规则约束的DeGroot观点更新下的会议共识形成问题，建立了全局共识的充分条件，证明全额报销中介会议成本时信息获取博弈具有加权势并存在纯策略纳什均衡，并开发了基于验证收益界的数值方法来认证近似均衡和评估部分报销政策。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes sufficient conditions for global consensus in conferences with KL-divergence-based acceptance rules, proves that the information-acquisition game admits a weighted potential and pure-strategy Nash equilibrium under full mediator cost reimbursement, and develops a verified numerical procedure to certify approximate equilibria and assess partial reimbursement policies.
